title: CAT 2024 Question Paper (Slot 1, QA) - Quant - Speed Time Distance Races
subject: Quant

questions.q: Two places A and B are 45 kms apart and connected by a straight road. Anil goes from A to B while Sunil goes from B to A. Starting at the same time, they cross each other in exactly 1 hour 30 minutes. If Anil reaches B exactly 1 hour 15 minutes after Sunil reaches A, the speed of Anil, in km per hour, is
questions.explain: Let speeds of Anil and Sunil be $v_A$ and $v_S$. They meet in 1.5 hours. So, $1.5(v_A+v_S)=45 \Rightarrow v_A+v_S=30$. Time taken for Anil is $T_A=45/v_A$ and for Sunil is $T_S=45/v_S$. We are given $T_A = T_S + 1.25$. Substituting $v_S=30-v_A$ leads to a quadratic equation. A quicker way is to test the options. If $v_A=12$, then $v_S=18$. $T_A=45/12 = 3.75$ hr. $T_S=45/18=2.5$ hr. The difference is $3.75-2.5 = 1.25$ hr, which matches the condition.
